description: This file defines the PermissionService interface, which specifies methods for managing permissions within the sales manager application's user service module. It includes methods to retrieve, save, delete, and list permissions based on various criteria.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of permissions by name, though specific parameters are not provided.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Lists all permissions, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a permission based on its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new permission or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a list of group IDs.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission for a given group.
